gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.blubguh: Rarity: Rare (De Zingende Weide and Guh Dreamland; you only see wild Blubs once you helped Snoes)
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sterrenvisje: Rarity: Rare (the moon pond of the Moon Mill, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sterrenvisje: A tiny fish with little stars for fins. It glows softly in four colours and leaves sparkles behind. Smells of star dust. Don't feed it: it only eats dreams.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.snoes: Rarity: Unique (by your bed, one evening; later on the Dream Square)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.snoes: A scruffy stray guh with a bent ear and a plaster. He never had a place of his own, so he never dared to sleep. After his dream he sleeps in a box of nibbles (not in the lovely cat house, of course).
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.zandguh: Rarity: Unique (the Moon Mill, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.zandguh: The guh who grinds dreams into dream sand. Nightcap, starry nightgown and a sack full of glitter. He never sprinkles too much, or you'd sleep through breakfast. Very sleepy.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wekkerguh: Rarity: Unique (the Dream Square, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wekkerguh: A guh with an alarm clock on his back and little bells on his ears. Talk to him and you wake up. He rings very softly, because nobody likes waking up loudly. Njeg... five more minutes?
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.rommelguh: Rarity: Unique (the Memory Island, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rommelguh: Wherever Rommelguh has been, there's a glass with a little bit left. Juice, cola, lemonade... they're never quite empty. 'That one isn't finished!' he says. Tidying up? Tomorrow. Maybe.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.droom_omaguh: Rarity: Unique (the Memory Island, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.droom_omaguh: Grandma guh as she is in the memory of the Guh Family Day: with knitting needles, a ball of wool and a tin full of pink guh cookies. 'Another cookie, sweetie?' Yes, grandma.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kussengevecht_guh: Rarity: Rare (the Star Pillow Field, in Guh Dreamland)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kussengevecht_guh: Pyjamas on, nightcap on and a pillow in his paws. He throws his pillow at anyone who comes close. It never hurts, only feathers. Only soft fights, njeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.bubbelbadguh: Rarity: Rare (the bath hut by the Bubble Sap Pools in De Zingende Weide)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bubbelbadguh: Lifeguard Bubbles of the Bubble Sap Pools. He hands out a little towel every day and keeps an eye on the bathing Blubs. He always smells of soap and sings while drying off.
